BRIEF OF APPELLANT

Comity is a matter of grace, not obligation. Goss Int'l Corp. v. Man
Roland Druckmaschinen AG, 491 F.3d 355, 359 (8th Cir. 2007). The Eighth
Circuit explained the limits of antisuit injunctions. Goss, 491 F.3d at 363.
The principle is well settled in this circuit. Goss at 365.

The same rule governs under state law. Niemeyer v. Niemeyer, 2024 ND 156,
¶ 8, 9 N.W.3d 100. The district court must make specific findings.
Niemeyer, ¶ 12. The court repeated the point. 2024 ND 156 at ¶ 14.
Id. ¶ 15. Id. at ¶ 16.

The motion was argued at 363 before the panel. He lived at 363 Main
Street. See Smith at 17 for an unrelated treatise reference. The
argument is valid. Idaho at 22 discusses nothing.
